reason: I'd connect and take the free first collab since the café asked, but I'm not paying ₹499 for a pass when I mostly do barter anyway. The Auto-DM is the main paid feature and that's exactly the thing I'm scared will get my account flagged.
objection: Auto-DM could get my Instagram flagged or shadowbanned, and my small account is all I have. Also having to make promo videos for other businesses just because I bought a pass feels like unpaid work.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that Auto-DM runs through Instagram's official tools and won't get accounts flagged, plus the first collab actually getting me paid instead of just free food.
